citation: A. Poznak, V. Thole, P. Sanders, The Natural Aging Effect on Hardenability in Al-Mg-Si: A Complex Interaction between Composition and Heat Treatment Parameters, Metals 8 (2018) 309
processing: Section 2: homogenised 144 h at 575 C, extruded to 22 mm rod, solution treated 1.25 h at 560 C, water quenched (WQ), naturally aged 0.5 h or 4 h, artificially aged at 175 C; Vickers macro-hardness, 20 kg load, at least six indents; error bars 95% confidence
digitisation: Peak hardness and time to peak read by eye from 300 dpi renders of Fig. 3 (high-solute, WQ) and Fig. 10 (low-solute, WQ); reading uncertainty about +-1 HV and one data point in time. Peak = highest plotted mean of the 0.5 h NA curve; NA loss = peak(0.5 h NA) - peak(4 h NA).
